saw_lines: Coffee buyers stick with one roast and one brew method, then reorder the same bag before it runs out.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, when a stranger decides if the roast is worth trying.
Your 16 copy ads carry 0 proof numbers, so buyers have no reason to trust the roast. Collect one review count or orders shipped and lead with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 17 Oct 2026
points: 0 of 16 copy ads carry a proof number, so a first time buyer has nothing concrete to trust before paying. Collect one number, like a review count or orders shipped, and put it on every creative in the next batch.
0 of 16 copy ads mention an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Give new buyers one reason to act, like a first order discount, and open the next three ads with it.
24 ads have run 60+ days, yet none of the 6 newer ads reuses an opening line from them. Build the next three ads as variations of your oldest winner, so the proven story keeps working.

12 different opening stories run across 16 copy ads, and the biggest one leads 3 of them, so no story gets a real test. Pick the two strongest openings, such as the workshop invite, and build the next batch from them.

ads_1: Origin-led creative: Honduras, Colombia and Peru stories, each with a first order offer
